      public RequestOptions.Builder idempotencyKey(String idempotencyKey)
      Set the idempotency key for this request. Idempotency keys allow safe retrying of POST requests without accidentally duplicating operations.
      Parameters:
      idempotencyKey - a unique identifier for the request (e.g., UUID)
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
